data.purpose: task-specific public heldout live validation screening
data.scope_limit: Balanced small samples; not broad representative media or general reasoning evidence. Upstream foundation-model pretraining overlap cannot be audited from these sources.

selection_policy.boolq: 64 true/64 false train and test; 8/8 calibration; unique passage SHA groups
selection_policy.boolq_full_train: 128/class (256 total), strict superset of the 128-case pilot train; same seeded label pools skip every existing train/calibration/test passage group
selection_policy.boolq_schema: One fixed NOUL schema; original passage and question preserved in request state.
selection_policy.mnist: official test only; fixed-seed stratified sample; 4 digits 0/1 and 3 others
selection_policy.fsdd: official test recordings 0-4; 2 per digit; all 6 speakers; speaker groups
selection_policy.ontology: complete false/true or digit-0..digit-9 plus unknown; no truncation

boolq.publisher: Google Research; Christopher Clark et al. (2019)
boolq.label_policy: official labeled validation used for test; unlabeled test not used
boolq.transport_note: Original official GCS files returned 403; Google HF mirror used.

mnist.publisher: Yann LeCun, Corinna Cortes, Christopher J.C. Burges
mnist.transform: 28x28 grayscale inverted; nearest enlargement to 224x224 RGB PNG

fsdd.transform: 8kHz mono PCM normalized by decoder; polyphase upsample to 16kHz; clip
fsdd.source_group: speaker; six groups limit independent statistical evidence

data.M0_annotation: unknown is separately assigned because the sole digit evidence is removed
data.M2_annotation: Oracle descriptions derived from published human digit labels. No new independent human listening or transcription review. Diagnostic only; not a production capability.
